calculators.description_native: Bereken je netto maandsalaris in België op basis van je bruto salaris, gezinstoestand, kinderen ten laste en voordelen alle aard (VAA). / Calculez votre salaire net mensuel en Belgique.

inputs.label_native: 13e maand / Eindejaarspremie (13e mois)

calculators.formula_explanation: Gross Salary - Employee RSZ/ONSS (13.07%) = Taxable Gross Base. Fringe benefits (VAA company car) are added to Taxable Base. Professional Withholding Tax (Bedrijfsvoorheffing / Précompte professionnel) is calculated using progressive tax scales (25%, 40%, 45%, 50%), reduced by tax-free allowance (€10,570 base) and per-child dependent tax credits (e.g. €42/mo for 1 child, €118/mo for 2 children). Special Social Security Contribution (BBSZ / CSSS) is applied on a sliding scale up to €60.94/mo. Low earners get a Work Bonus (Werkbonus) reducing employee RSZ. Net Salary = Gross - RSZ - Withholding Tax - BBSZ.

calculators.formula_explanation: Registration Tax (Verkooprecht / Droits d'enregistrement): Flanders reduced rate for sole primary home is 3% (1% for major energy renovation - IER), standard rate 12%. Brussels rate 12.5% with €200,000 tax-free Abattement allowance on properties ≤ €600,000. Wallonia rate 12.5% with €40,000 Abattement exemption for primary residence. Statutory Notary Fees (Honoraria) follow royal decree sliding bracket scale: 4.56% (<€7.5k) down to 0.057% (>€250k). Fixed administrative fees (~€800-€1,100) + 21% VAT on notary service. Mortgage Deed Costs include 1% mortgage registration duty, conservator fee, notary scale, and admin fees.

calculators.description_native: Simuleer het netto-inkomen als eenmanszaak t.o.v. besloten vennootschap (BV / SRL) in België inclusief sociale bijdragen, vennootschapsbelasting en VVPRbis dividenden.

inputs.label_native: Jaarlijkse bruto omzet (€ excl. BTW) / Chiffre d'affaires annuel (€ HTVA)

inputs.name: business_expenses
inputs.label_native: Beroepskosten (€ excl. BTW) / Frais professionnels (€ HTVA)

inputs.name: director_salary
inputs.label_native: Voorgestelde bruto bestuurdersbezoldiging BV (€/jaar) / Rémunération de dirigeant SRL (€/an)

inputs.name: vvprbis_eligible
inputs.label_native: Recht op VVPRbis verlaagde roerende voorheffing (15%)?

calculators.formula_explanation: Sole Proprietorship: Net Profit = Revenue - Expenses. Social Security = 20.5% on net profit up to €70,857, 14.16% up to €104,422. Taxable net income after social security is taxed under personal income tax (25%-50% + municipal surcharge ~7%). Company (BV/SRL): Corporate Taxable Profit = Revenue - Expenses - Director Salary. SME Corporate Tax = 20% on first €100,000 (if min director salary of €45,000 is met), 25% on remaining. Post-tax company profits paid as dividends taxed at 15% (VVPRbis) or 30%. Director salary is taxed as personal income + social contributions. Crossover point for BV advantage is typically ~€45,000-€55,000 net profit.

calculators.title_en: Belgium Student Job 600-Hour Quota & Tax Calculator
calculators.description_native: Bereken je netto loon als student, controleer je resterende quota van 600 uur en voorkom dat je de grens voor kind ten laste of belastingvrije som overschrijdt.

inputs.name: hourly_wage
inputs.label_native: Bruto uurloon (€) / Salaire brut horaire (€)

inputs.name: hours_worked_this_year
inputs.label_native: Reeds gewerkte uren dit kalenderjaar / Heures déjà effectuées cette année

inputs.name: planned_hours
inputs.label_native: Nieuw aantal geplande uren / Nouvelles heures prévues

inputs.name: other_gross_income
inputs.label_native: Andere bruto inkomsten dit jaar (€) / Autres revenus bruts (€)

inputs.name: parent_marital_status
inputs.label_native: Gezinssituatie ouders / Situation des parents

calculators.formula_explanation: Students can work up to 600 hours per calendar year under solidarity rate (Solidariteitsbijdrage). Within 600 hours, employee RSZ is reduced to 2.71% (vs 13.07% standard) and no withholding tax is deducted. Above 600 hours, standard RSZ (13.07%) and tax withholding apply. Annual earnings up to €10,570 are exempt from personal tax (belastingvrije som). To remain dependent child for parents' tax deduction (kind ten laste), student net income cannot exceed €3,984 (married parents) or €5,750 (single parent), with the first tranche of student job earnings (~€3,190) legally excluded from the dependent calculation.

calculators.description_native: Bereken het bruto en netto Voordeel Alle Aard (VAA / ATN) voor je bedrijfswagen in België, evenals de fiscale aftrekbaarheid en CO2-solidariteitsbijdrage voor werkgevers.

inputs.name: catalog_value
inputs.label_native: Cataloguswaarde wagen incl. opties en BTW (€) / Valeur catalogue (€ TTC)

inputs.name: fuel_type
inputs.label_native: Brandstoftype / Type de carburant

inputs.name: co2_emissions
inputs.label_native: CO2-uitstoot (g/km) / Émissions CO2 (g/km)

inputs.name: age_of_car_months
inputs.label_native: Leeftijd wagen (maanden sinds 1e inschrijving) / Âge (mois)

inputs.name: marginal_tax_rate
inputs.label_native: Marginaal belastingtarief / Taux marginal d'imposition

calculators.formula_explanation: Annual VAA/ATN = Catalog Value * Age Coefficient * CO2 Percentage * (6/7). Age coefficient reduces by 6%/year down to min 70% after 6 years. CO2 Percentage: Electric vehicles use min reference 4.0%. Petrol/Hybrid: 5.5% + (CO2 - Petrol_Reference) * 0.1%. Diesel: 5.5% + (CO2 - Diesel_Reference) * 0.1%. CO2 percentage capped between 4% and 18%. Legal minimum annual VAA applies (~€1,600). Net monthly tax cost to employee = (Annual VAA * Marginal Tax Rate) / 12. Corporate tax deductibility formula = 120% - (0.5% * fuel_coeff * CO2_g_km), with zero-emission EV cars 100% deductible.
